text:
lena_sales: FYI ACME asked for a 2-week evaluation of a Dedicated pool spanning us-west and eu-west. We need a temporary autoscale/burst config and a region capacity split (roughly 20 GPUs us-west, 12 eu-west). Also need per-tenant API keys that rotate and an auditor-friendly access log.
raj_engineering: Got it. What's their expected concurrency and typical sequence length? That affects batching and kernel choices.
maria_se: For trials we usually set autoscale min_replicas=2, max_replicas=8 and a burst_credit_pool of 2000 tokens to handle spikes. 60s cooldown, 3min scale window. Would that work for them?
lena_sales: They're going to run chat sessions with avg seq ~1024 and peak QPS ~60 during demo windows. Some evals push longer.
raj_engineering: For 1024 sequences and 60 QPS we should bias capacity to lower-latency lane in us-west. Suggest reserving the 20 GPUs in us-west as guaranteed, label them as "low-latency" and keep eu-west for overflow.
tom_infra: Provision note: committed capacity change + cross-region split requires a billing ticket and an infra reservation. ETA ~48-72h after ticket approval. Also need a formal change request form for the Dedicated pool sizing.
kevin_sre: Security flags: must use KMS-backed keys, IP allowlist for their CIDR, no long-lived shared API keys. We can issue ephemeral keys (24h) for demos and rotate them automatically. Also enable audit logs to a customer-owned S3 bucket for compliance.
lena_sales: Can you provide an approximate cost delta for adding the extra reserved 32 GPUs for 2 weeks (incl burst credits)? Need a ballpark to get sign-off.
tom_infra: Rough estimate: equivalent to a 2-week pro-rated reserved capacity charge + burst premium. I'll ping billing and get a number, should have a quote within one business day.
provision-bot: Created ticket PROV-4821: "ACME trial Dedicated - region split + autoscale/burst". Assigned to @tom_infra and @raj_engineering. Link: https://redwood.example/prov/PROV-4821
maria_se: Example autoscale snippet to start from (tweak once we have real load):
```json
{
  "policy_name": "trial-acme-autoscale",
  "min_replicas": 2,
  "max_replicas": 8,
  "burst_credit_pool": 2000,
  "cooldown_seconds": 60,
  "scale_window_seconds": 180,
  "region_preferences": {"us-west": 20, "eu-west": 12}
}
```
raj_engineering: We'll also add prefix KV caching for common demo prompts to reduce token costs. Can we enable a temporary cache policy scoped to ACME's tenant?
kevin_sre: Yes, but ensure cache keys are hashed and no PII is stored. We'll include a cache retention policy of 1 hour for the trial.
lena_sales: Awesome. Next steps: tom files the reservation change + billing quote, raj and maria prepare config for PROV-4821, kevin prepares the ephemeral key flow and S3 audit hookup. I'll loop in the account team after the cost quote. :thumbsup:
provision-bot: PROV-4821 status updated to "in progress" by tom_infra at 1846007890
kevin_sre: One more: add a canary fallback route to a smaller quantized model if latency breaches SLO. That keeps demo stable.
lena_sales: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll wait for the cost number and the provisioning ETA.
